evidence.summary: With the other baseline inputs held fixed, changing comorbidity_ratio from 0 to 1 changed the score from 0.9786 to 0.8177, a decrease of 0.1609.

At years_registered = 0 the observed score was 0.9684, while values around 5 to 20 produced approximately 0.9786 under otherwise similar baseline inputs. This suggests a possible threshold or nonlinear effect near the low end, but the exact threshold was not established.
